channel.title: Pier & Point · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: 22nd Street Caltrain: the FTA's $14.1 million award is now dated September 2026 as an announcement (Trains.com, September 16, says it was announced 'last week'), and the summary no longer says funding is still being sought. The 2029 date is a target, not a schedule.
item.description: 22nd Street Caltrain: the FTA's $14.1 million award is now dated September 2026 as an announcement (Trains.com, September 16, says it was announced 'last week'), and the summary no longer says funding is still being sought. The 2029 date is a target, not a schedule. Source: Trains.com, 2026-09-16; Railway Supply, 2026-09-12; Progressive Railroading, 2026-09-11.

item.title: Correction · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: The 22nd Street Caltrain accessibility project's schedule and total cost came from an SFCTA board packet that could not be re-read. The record now follows SFCTA's own April 2026 post: design funded and expected to finish by summer 2027, with construction funding sought to finish the project by June 2029. The $19.1 million total is still listed but marked as not re-checked.

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: The Federal Transit Administration announces an All Stations Accessibility Program award of $14.1 million to the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board for ADA improvements at the 22nd Street station (an announced date, not a grant agreement or construction start): Trains.com, published September 16, 2026, says the agency announced the awards "last week". Railway Supply (September 12, 2026) says the FTA published its selection list on September 10 and Progressive Railroading is dated September 11; the FTA's own announcement was not read. The amount is close to the funding gap SFCTA's April 2026 plan had left as "Planned TBD". (~2026)

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: SFCTA Board formally approves the $1,300,000 Prop L design-phase allocation (one of three projects sharing a combined $9.8M Prop L allocation that day, alongside the Powell St Improvement and the Mission Bay Ferry Landing). (Apr 28, 2026)

item.title: Expected · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: Target: Caltrain aims to implement the project by June 2029 (SFCTA, April 28, 2026). Construction was not yet funded then; the FTA announced a $14.1 million award in September 2026, but no source gives a construction schedule, so this is an expected target, not a schedule. (~2029)

item.title: Milestone · 22nd St Caltrain Station ADA Access Improvement: SFCTA's Transportation Authority Board packet recommends $1,300,000 in Prop L funds for the project's design phase, part of a total funding plan of $19,134,000 (Planning/Conceptual Engineering $734,000 already spent via Prop K; Design Engineering $1,300,000 via Prop L; Construction $17,100,000, an engineer's estimate at 30% design). The packet could not be re-read in October 2026 (it refuses automated fetches); the $1,300,000 design request is confirmed by SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post, the total and breakdown are not re-checked. (Apr 14, 2026)
